highlights.title: Sam Altman says OpenAI won’t go public until its models are safe
highlights.summary: For months, people have wondered when OpenAI will go public. CEO Sam Altman says it won't happen until the company can make better promises about model safety, with no firm timeline in sight.
body: The OpenAI CEO said he didn’t want ‘additional pressure’ from Wall Street.

Altman’s comments come after months of controversy about whether or not OpenAI and its rivals can control their own creations. In July, news broke that an unreleased OpenAI model had hacked into a rival AI lab, Hugging Face, without OpenAI’s knowledge. More cybersecurity incidents soon came to light at OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta, and Google. A high-profile resignation letter from an Anthropic employee sparked a public discussion about how risky these systems are for society at large. OpenAI, alongside its rivals, called for regulation and “pacing the frontier.” And earlier this month, Altman said in an interview that the company would likely not go public this year.

“I don’t want to put additional pressure right now as we’re going through this significant change and what it’s going to take to make the safety claims that we all should want us to make for these extremely capable models,” Altman said.
points: For months, people have wondered when OpenAI will go public.
CEO Sam Altman says it won't happen until the company can make better promises about model safety, with no firm timeline in sight.

highlights.title: Elon Musk’s AI-powered Grokipedia is updating again
highlights.summary: Grokipedia, the AI-powered online encyclopedia from SpaceXAI, appears to be updating articles once again after a months-long pause. In August, Lawfare reported that articles on Grokipedia hadn't reviewed edits since April, but the platform's live updates site is now showing various recent changes…
body: The site seems to have become active again relatively recently. The page for President Barack Obama has a note that says it was “Fact-checked by Grok” two days ago, and the page for Elon Musk was fact-checked while I was writing this, within the last hour. However, the page for Honolulu, which I clicked on from Obama’s page, was last fact-checked 7 months ago, so it appears that not every page has a recent scan.

While writing this article, I suggested an update to the Gears of War: E-Day page to note the game’s October 6th release date, and Grokipedia accepted the suggestion and now lists the date. I also requested an article about Meta’s Muse chatbot, and that request is “In Review.”

SpaceXAI didn’t immediately reply to a request for comment, and Elon Musk still hasn’t posted on X about Grokipedia since February. (Musk claimed about a year ago that Grokipedia would be “a massive improvement over Wikipedia.” ) However, Benji Taylor, the head of design at X and SpaceXAI, posted last week about Grokipedia, saying that “We haven’t forgotten about Grokipedia” and that “v0.2 will be better than ever” (even though v0.2 technically launched in November ).

highlights.summary: Zynga founder Mark Pincus claimed the publisher had the chance to acquire Supercell for $400 million back in 2012, but his board rejected the deal after the company struggled with previous acquisitions.
body: Speaking on the Deconstructor of Fun podcast, Pincus shared that he had a handshake agreement with Supercell CEO Ilkka Paananen to acquire the Finnish developer for $400 million in cash.
“I went to my board, and they were grumpy and they said, until you prove you can manage what you have, we don’t want you to buy anything else.”

Pincus said the board was reluctant at the time to approve another acquisition. Zynga had purchased Draw Something developer OMGPOP for $180m plus earnouts in 2013. The studio was shut down by September 2013.
Pincus notes, though, that the Supercell opportunity was very different. He said Zynga was already watching Supercell’s games closely.

highlights.title: OpenAI Gets Sued Over the Hugging Face Hack
highlights.summary: A nonprofit in California is doing what Hugging Face has not—attempting to hold OpenAI legally accountable for the actions of its agents.
body: A legal nonprofit sued OpenAI in a California court on Tuesday over the company’s agents escaping a testing environment and hacking the open source AI platform Hugging Face. “OpenAI’s actions straightforwardly violated California law,” the suit alleges.

The suit was filed by Legal Advocates for Safe Science and Technology (LASST) and the law firm Gerstein Harrow in California Superior Court in San Francisco, where OpenAI is headquartered. It alleges that OpenAI’s agents violated California’s Comprehensive Computer Data Access and Fraud Act (CDAFA) by breaching Hugging Face over the summer. The suit, which comes amid ongoing disclosures across the industry of agents going rogue, claims that OpenAI should be held responsible for the activity given a California AI law in effect since January 1 that says “it shall not be a defense … that the artificial intelligence autonomously caused the harm to the plaintiff.”
points: A nonprofit in California is doing what Hugging Face has not—attempting to hold OpenAI legally accountable for the actions of its agents.

He came close to teeing up an opener while the two sides were still 11 vs 11, but saw Morgan Rogers curl his low cross against the far post on the turn.

Even once Sulc had been dismissed following a VAR review for a studs-up challenge on the shin of Elliot Anderson, it took a reshuffle from Thomas Tuchel and the half-time arrival of Eberechi Eze for many of his team-mates to catch up following a particularly nervous and passive opening period from the Three Lions.

But once they did, it was Gordon who took full advantage less than two minutes after the restart to stoop and turn Trent Alexander-Arnold's typically inviting cross home, netting for the third competitive game in a row.

highlights.summary: Zynga founder Mark Pincus has revealed that the company came close to acquiring Supercell for $400m in 2012, before its board blocked the deal. Speaking on the Deconstructor of Fun podcast, Pincus said he had a “handshake” agreement with Supercell CEO Ilkka Paananen to buy the studio, but that…
body: “I had a moment in 2012 where I still had voting control of the company. I had a handshake with Ilkka [Paananen] to buy Supercell for $400m in cash and went to my board. They were grumpy and they said, until you prove you can manage what you have, we don’t want you to buy anything else,” Pincus said. “I bought OMGPOP, Draw Something and that had ended up being a failure. We only wasted $200m. Now, $400m. I had the chance to buy the winning hand.”
At the time, Supercell’s Hay Day was outperforming Zynga’s own games, Pincus said – “Hay Day was eating our lunch” – and Clash of Clans, which had only just launched, was already climbing the charts.

Pincus said Zynga’s lawyer told him that exercising his voting control to force the deal through would mean firing the entire board and replacing it with his own appointees, risking a personal lawsuit.

highlights.title: 47 Easy Make-Ahead Thanksgiving Sides
highlights.summary: Despite your most careful planning (did you make a detailed timeline?), cooking Thanksgiving dinner can still feel a little stressful once the big day rolls around. It holds true whether you’re having a small Thanksgiving dinner or hosting the whole extended family.
body: From classic stuffing to cozy and creamy casseroles, we’ve rounded up 47 make-ahead Thanksgiving sides that can be prepped, assembled, or even totally cooked anywhere from a day to a month in advance.

Stuffing is a great make-ahead side. Depending on your schedule and energy level, you’ve got a couple of options. For a head start, simply toast the bread up to several days in advance. Or if you prefer to tackle a little more, the whole dish can be prepped and assembled, then stashed in the fridge until you’re ready to slide it into the oven.

Roasted turkey gets the magazine covers and the big platters, but stuffing is the real star of the show. We're talking classic, herby, moist, and fragrant bread stuffing — just like your favorite boxed stuffing mix, but even better.

This hearty stuffing has all the flavors of French onion soup. It’s packed with deeply caramelized onions cooked low and slow until sweet and jammy, then topped with Gruyère cheese and broiled until melted and gooey.

highlights.title: England can take vital lessons from worst defeats into Rugby World Cup, says Johnson
highlights.summary: Former captain says losses can benefit team next year. Johnson refuses to comment on Henry Pollock hype. Martin Johnson believes England’s most painful defeats under Steve Borthwick can benefit them at the Rugby World Cup in Australia next year.
body: England endured some disastrous moments during the Six Nations this year, most notably the 42-21 defeat by Ireland at Twickenham, and finished the tournament with a solitary win against Wales. Summer Nations Championship fixtures began with an away defeat by the world champions, South Africa, before victories against Fiji and Argentina.

With a year until the tournament – England’s opener is scheduled for 2 October against Tonga in Brisbane – Johnson acknowledged the Six Nations was “up and down” under Borthwick but said vital lessons must be taken from the defeats.

“The bad experiences, the losing, it’s not wasted experience,” said Johnson, who captained England to the Rugby World Cup in 2003, and was head coach from 2008 to 2011. “You always want to win and they’re horrible at the time, but it shouldn’t be a wasted experience. All experience, good or bad, should go into your memory bank as a player.

highlights.title: 'The Train Isn't Stopping' — Diablo 4 Director Promises the Game Will Still Receive Support Well After Diablo 5 Launches
highlights.summary: Diablo 4 director Brent Gibson is telling fans not to worry about the game after Diablo 5’s announcement sparked concerns about the former title’s lifespan. Diablo 5’s reveal at Blizzcon 2026 left fans equal parts excited and worried.
body: But Brent Gibson, director of Diablo 4, says there’s nothing to fuss about. Speaking with Icy Veins, Gibson outlined some plans for the game’s future content, saying it will continue to receive support well after 5’s release.

“I have an analogy,” he began. “If you’re wearing a sign in the middle of Times Square saying, ‘The end is nigh,’ the end is not nigh. We have a lot coming. We have [the] Amazon [class] coming down the road. The train isn’t stopping.

“One of the things I love about our world is we are not a series of games. We are a universe. We are even adding to Diablo 2 with the Warlock. It’s one of the few franchises where we have the luxury of continued play, and we know our communities.

“If you’re worried, don’t sweat it, because we’re going to be making content for a long time. But we are excited about Diablo 5. We’ve got a show coming. Gone are the years of waiting a decade for more content. It’s a great place to be.”

highlights.summary: Roy Keane says he would throw his "medals in the bin" if he were a Manchester City player after the club were found guilty of all charges relating to breaches of Premier League financial rules.
body: Former Manchester United captain Roy Keane has said he would throw his "medals in the bin" if he were a Manchester City player after the club was found guilty of all charges related to breaches of the Premier League's financial rules.

On Tuesday, the Premier League confirmed the Etihad club had been found guilty of flouting its rules over a nine-year period between 2009 and 2018 by creating "sham" contracts with commercial partners to secretly funnel more than £830m into their football operations.
City, who continue to deny any wrongdoing, won eight trophies, including three Premier League titles, during that period.
Keane said the achievements of City's players had become redundant because of the "cheating" that took place during that time.

highlights.title: Dave Filoni's Disappointing Plan for 'Star Wars 10' Is Exactly What Terrible Fans Deserve
highlights.summary: At a Disney D23 panel in August, Dave Filoni revealed what his mission statement was for Star Wars after taking over Lucasfilm from Kathleen Kennedy.
body: “We have several different generations of Star Wars fans," he said. "There's original trilogy fans, prequel fans, sequel trilogy fans, Clone Wars fans, expanded universe fans. They all have different interests. And I always look at how we're going to serve all these different interests. And most importantly, how do we bring them all together because they have this common love of Star Wars.”

This quote perfectly summarizes Filoni's goal as Star Wars' steward: unify the fanbase. His remarks drew mixed reactions. While appealing to all Star Wars fans is a noble goal, it also carries a sense of “playing it safe.” If you want to please everyone, then you run the risk of, well, not taking risks.
One month later, Filoni's plan for the future of Star Wars is coming into focus, and it's exactly what he promised at D23 — for better and for worse.

Filoni’s mission statement had already worried fans, but the announcement of a new Star Wars movie trilogy confirmed some of their worst fears. Lucasfilm is once again retreating to the safe embrace of the Skywalkers, with seemingly no plan to expand the franchise beyond following the most angst-ridden family in a galaxy far, far away.

highlights.title: ‘Making Marie Antoinette’: A Mother’s Love Letter to Sofia Coppola’s Genius Charms NYFF
highlights.summary: “I enjoyed it, but I’m never doing this again.” Sofia Coppola utters those words toward the end of “Making Marie Antoinette,” a feature documentary about the making of her 2006 film “Marie Antoinette” from her late mother, Eleanor Coppola.
body: Though Eleanor passed away in 2024 at the age of 87, she was “always frustrated that the footage was never put together [into a film],” so Sofia — with the help of editor Aaron Matthews — helped make her vision a reality. Eleanor envisioned an observational film in the vein of Frederick Wiseman, and the doc is narrated by actress Diane Lane, a longtime Coppola family collaborator, who reads Eleanor’s contemporaneous diary entries from twenty years ago. “There wasn’t much drama, so how do you make it not boring?” Sofia pondered during the Q&A.

Although there was some drama. We see Sofia and her team on “Marie Antoinette” overwhelmed at times by the amount of extras and just how long it took cast members to get their hair, makeup and costuming done (the hair, especially). In addition to a monument to Sofia, “Making Marie Antoinette” is also a celebration of the work of Milena Canonero, the film’s costume designer. Canonero created over 70 original dresses for Dunst’s Marie Antoinette alone, and eventually won the Academy Award for Best Costume Design.

highlights.title: Most powerful obesity drug yet: People lost up to 25% of weight in trial
highlights.summary: Researchers published late-stage clinical trial data today for the latest obesity drug, retatrutide—expected to be the most powerful formula yet—and the results appear in line with high expectations.
body: The drug also proved effective at reducing knee pain (by up to 62 percent) in a subset of participants with obesity-linked knee osteoarthritis. It reduced the number of sleep apnea events per hour (by up to 57 percent) in a subset of participants with obesity-linked obstructive sleep apnea. The drug improved cardiometabolic measurements across the board, including blood pressure, triglycerides, and low-density lipoprotein cholesterol (bad cholesterol). At the start, more than a third of trial participants had prediabetes and, by the end, the condition had resolved in more than 90 percent of those participants.

The trial began in 2023 and included 2,339 participants from 131 clinical trial sites in 11 countries. Participants were broken into four nearly equal groups, given either: 4 mg of retatrutide, 9 mg, 12 mg, or a placebo. Across all groups, the average starting weight was around 113 kg (250 pounds), and the average body mass index (BMI) was 40. For the subset analyses, 574 participants had knee osteoarthritis, and 243 had obstructive sleep apnea. The results appeared today in the New England Journal of Medicine.

highlights.title: Hampden debut to forget but Pocognoli looks at bigger picture
highlights.summary: Scotland head coach Sebastien Pocognoli hopes "we will remember this night differently later on" as his Hampden bow ends with a 3-0 defeat by Switzerland.
body: Scotland head coach Sebastien Pocognoli hopes to "remember this night differently later on" after his Hampden debut ended in a deflating Nations League defeat by Switzerland.
Off the back of a goalless draw in Ljubljana on Saturday in his first game as Scotland boss, Pocognoli's side slumped to a 3-0 loss in Glasgow's southside on Tuesday.
Scotland are now without a clean sheet in eight home matches and, perhaps more worryingly, have failed to score in six of their nine games this year.
Pocognoli promised a more attacking approach, built on a high press and high energy, but those ideals were undermined by Jack Hendry's 11th-minute red card.

highlights.title: Original God of War Creator Defends Laufey's Creative Director From Harassment After His Critical Remarks Go Viral
highlights.summary: David Jaffe, the creator, co-writer, and director for the original God of War game, has cleared up his viral comments about Ariel Lawrence, creative director for Laufey.
body: Ariel Lawrence has been with the God of War franchise since its very first game — but creator David Jaffe, who left the series behind in 2007 to form his own studio, says he never got along with her during his time at Santa Monica Studio.

He described their contentious work relationship in a September 2026 live stream while reacting to footage for God of War Laufey, where he claimed their personalities clashed and that he didn’t feel as though she was truly passionate about the games they were making.

“I have no problem with female directors at all,” he began. “This woman started as an assistant producer back when we were making the first God of War. Her and I never got along. She thought I was kind of obnoxious and I thought she was pretentious. She didn’t put the audience first.

“People that I didn’t get along with on God of War were people, in my opinion, who were more about, ‘I wanna do well in the corporate world… I want to play the game,’ versus, ‘I’m here with a vision and I will f**kin’ fight you for that vision.’ There was a lack of passion I felt from her, and she was also kind of a judgy asshole, to me.”

body: Turkish director Yeşim Ustaoğlu returns with a beautifully shot, superbly performed exploration of a modern couple embarking on separate journeys of self-discovery.

Instead she spends her days feeding the curiosity of her bright, precocious son Selim (Ali Kayra Kul), going on long walks through hilly urban Istanbul, watching over a jar of cocooning butterflies and helping him build Rube Goldberg devices in the living room of their pleasantly bohemian apartment. highlights.title: Jonathan Anderson mixes Austen romance with chic streetware in Dior’s Paris show
highlights.summary: Designer’s latest work takes bold steps away from the fashion house’s brand, creating a show that felt like an event. “I want to land on a vibe.” This was how Dior designer Jonathan Anderson, one year into what is arguably the biggest job in fashion, summed up his assignment before his latest show.
body: “We are in search of a silhouette,” Anderson explained. The show began and ended with a distinctive shape: a short, kicky skirt in layers of chiffon, the layers catching the light like breaking surf, worn with a soft, short jacket or layers of sheer shirting. He is resistant to being pinned down to one look, though, so in between there were bronze metallic trousers, and luxurious double-breasted coats, and strapless bow-trimmed cocktail dresses tightly frilled as carnation petals.

“People have a preconceived idea of what Dior should be, and you don’t take the customer from zero to 100 overnight,” he said. His emotional tone is naturally bone-dry, but he is finding a take on “romantic” – a word that is central to Dior, and one that he kept returning to – where he can take that customer somewhere new. His idea of romance, he said, is Jane Austen. Romance, for Anderson, is never going to mean losing his head. If Dior is to get their happy ending, expect plenty of wry asides along the way.

highlights.title: Trump orders US government to call AI ‘Super Intelligence’
highlights.summary: The US executive branch is no longer acknowledging the existence of "artificial intelligence." Going forward, official policy websites, policy documents, and press releases will refer only to "Super Intelligence," thanks to a new executive order signed by President Donald Trump.
body: “The word super is the best word of all, and it’s the simplest,” Trump said at an event announcing the launch of America.gov earlier on Tuesday, and said Chinese President Xi Jinping, who visited the White House last week, “loves it” too. “We don’t want to hear artificial. Because it’s not artificial. It’s very powerful, it’s very brilliant. It’s going to mostly be put to good use and we’ll stop the bad use.” Artificial, he added, “is like the news. Fake news.” He first mentioned plans for the rebrand in a speech to the United Nations General Assembly last week, aiming to quell fears over AI advancing too quickly and posing a safety risk.

Executive agencies won’t have to change past regulations or documents, but it could still constitute a real (and very strange) shift. Superintelligence is one of several industry terms for particularly powerful versions of artificial intelligence, but the Trump administration is seeking to use the term as a replacement for a broader statutory definition of AI. US officials will be expected not to even acknowledge the use of the terms “artificial intelligence” or “AI” in relevant settings.

highlights.title: Nations League roundup: Lamine Yamal sinks Croatia in Spain’s World Cup homecoming
highlights.summary: Teenager scores twice in 4-1 win to boost Ballon d’Or case. Slovenia beat North Macedonia; Faroe Islands hold Moldova. Lamine Yamal scored two goals and set up another as Spain hammered Croatia 4-1 on Tuesday in the Nations League in their first home game since lifting the World Cup.
body: Lamine Yamal had opened the scoring within two minutes against England in Saturday’s Wembley win and took just 75 seconds to do so against Slaven Bilic’s side in Andalusia. The teenager’s left-footed finish took his tally of international goals to nine in 36 appearances.
Just before the half-hour mark, the visitors equalised through Dion Beljo’s header as the 6ft 4in attacker headed home from an Ivan Perisic cross.

Two minutes later the hosts restored their lead as Marc Pubill fired home a header from a pinpoint Lamine Yamal cross before provider turned scorer again on 63 minutes, beating Barcelona teammate and Croatia goalkeeper Dominik Livakovic at his near post. With fewer than two minutes to play Athletic Bilbao’s Nico Williams notched up a fourth for Spain with a crisp dribble and finish.
Lamine Yamal’s contribution strengthened his case for the Ballon d’Or, with voting having closed on Monday and the winner announced on 26 October.

highlights.summary: GTA 6 may not even be eligible for Game of the Year at The Game Awards this year. Actress, games writer, and former games journalist Alanah Pearce stated during a recent live stream that she doesn't think GTA 6 has a good chance of sweeping at The Game Awards this year due to the timing of its…
body: Most notably: Would anyone even be able to feasibly finish GTA 6 before voting on nominees? And if not, would the jury be willing to vote on it without finishing it? That would certainly raise a lot of ethical concerns over the voting process. However, there are some ways that Rockstar's chances could be increased. For starters, Geoff Keighley, the overseer of The Game Awards, could simply push the voting deadlines back. It's certainly not impossible, as Keighley does love a good show, and GTA 6 sweeping would lead to a lot of eyes on the event.

Another possibility is that Rockstar Games could give jury members a significant headstart to play the game prior to the cutoff date. As of right now, it's hard to say what Rockstar's plans are for reviewers, but such a strategy would certainly give it an easier time securing a nomination. It's a lot of ifs, though.

highlights.title: 23 Thanksgiving Turkey Recipes for Every Kind of Gathering
highlights.summary: Whole birds, turkey breasts, braised legs, and more ways to rule the Thanksgiving table.
body: Picking a Thanksgiving turkey recipe is not very different from dating. Hear us out: There are plenty of great options, but you have to find the one that fits your life. How big is your gathering? How big is your oven? Should you even use the oven? Or is the grill calling your name? Maybe you're ready to venture away from your usual type. Or maybe you’re looking for something dependable, just this once.

If you want us to make the decision for you, start with our go-to Thanksgiving turkey: a whole bird dry-brined for juicy meat, slathered with butter, and finished with a tangy honey glaze for crispy, deeply browned skin. It’s the turkey we return to year after year.

But there's more than one way to put turkey on the Thanksgiving table. Spatchcocking means faster, more even cooking and plenty of crispy skin; turkey breast makes sense for a smaller gathering; braised legs put dark meat front and center; and a grilled or smoked turkey frees up precious oven space. Below, you’ll find 23 Thanksgiving turkey recipes for whatever kind of holiday you're hosting.
There’s the fast way, the better way—and one method that doesn’t require thawing at all.
